name: ask-ai
title: Ask AI
description: Ask a question from the root search and get a streamed answer from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or your logged-in coding CLIs
author: Nael-Nathanael

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.description: Ask a question and follow up in place. Works best as a fallback command

preferences.name: anthropicApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Key from console.anthropic.com, used by the Claude API provider

preferences.name: anthropicModel
preferences.title: Claude API Model
preferences.description: Model id for the Claude API provider

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API Key
preferences.description: Key from platform.openai.com, used by the OpenAI API provider

preferences.name: openaiModel
preferences.title: OpenAI API Model
preferences.description: Model id for the OpenAI API provider

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Gemini API Key
preferences.description: Key from aistudio.google.com, used by the Gemini API provider

preferences.name: geminiModel
preferences.title: Gemini API Model
preferences.description: Model id for the Gemini API provider

preferences.name: claudeCodeModel
preferences.title: Claude Code Model
preferences.description: Model passed to claude --model. Empty uses your Claude Code default

preferences.name: codexModel
preferences.title: Codex Model
preferences.description: Model passed to Codex. Empty uses your Codex default

preferences.name: antigravityModel
preferences.title: Antigravity Model
preferences.description: Model passed to agy --model (see agy models). Empty uses your Antigravity default

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System Prompt
preferences.default: You answer questions typed into a desktop launcher. Be direct and brief. Use Markdown.

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Extra PATH
preferences.description: Colon-separated folders searched for claude, codex and agy before PATH and ~/.local/bin
